description: PARTIAL SAVE: writes ONLY the 'Social' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel; all other v1/v2 fields stay untouched. In-game social layer - comments, following other players and reports, on top of the engine's shared social core (the same collections the platform's own social network uses, scoped to this title). Comments are OFF by default (CommentsEnabled): they are public text written by players, so turn them on only once you are ready to moderate them; CommentableTypes limits which objects accept comments (today only Workshop items). CommentMaxLength / CommentMaxLinks / CommentsPerDay, MaxFollowing / FollowsPerDay and ReportsPerDay are anti-spam ceilings; unset fields mean the platform defaults. Friends and the player's notification inbox (attacks, raids, new friend, Workshop sales and likes) need no configuration and are not here. Likes, favorites, follows, comments and reports themselves are NOT here - they are operational data in the shared Social* collections; reviewing reports and hiding comments are admin actions, not config.

value.description: In-game social layer: comments, following players, reports. Friends and the player's notification inbox work without this section. Every field is optional; an unset field means the platform default.

CommentMaxLength.description: Maximum comment length in characters. Unset = 500. Hard ceiling 2000.

CommentMaxLinks.description: Maximum links in one comment. Unset = 1; 0 forbids links entirely (the most common spam vector).

CommentableTypes.description: Which objects accept comments inside the game. Unset = Workshop items only. Allowed values: WorkshopItem.

CommentsEnabled.description: Enables in-game comments. Default OFF: comments are public text written by players, so the publisher turns them on explicitly once they are ready to moderate them (reports queue in the dashboard).

CommentsPerDay.description: Comments one player may post per UTC day across the title. Unset = 50.

FollowsPerDay.description: New follows one player may make per UTC day. Unset = 200. Guards against follow/unfollow churn used to spam notifications.

MaxFollowing.description: How many players one player may follow at once. Unset = 2000.

ReportsPerDay.description: Reports one player may file per UTC day. Unset = 20. Protects the moderation queue from report flooding.
